citation: Classified advertisement, 'To rent—2003 Indiana-av., stone front ... 12 rooms; recently decorated'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 17 October 1902 (vol. 61 no. 290).
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1902-10-17_61_290), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.
rights_note: A United States newspaper of 1902; public domain.
access_notes: Found by the Internet Archive's full-text search for the street address and read in the issue's OCR text for T-3013 on 2026-10-23; the page image was not consulted.
note: The house at 2003 Indiana Avenue offered to let in October 1902: a stone-fronted house of twelve rooms. (Ads of 25 May and 31 August 1902 offer the same number.)
what_it_supplies: that 2003 Indiana Avenue was a stone-fronted house of twelve rooms in 1902
